title: Geometry optimization of pristine C3B monolayer
action: Perform DFT geometry relaxation of a C3B monolayer in a suitable supercell using the PBE functional with Grimme D2 dispersion correction. Record the total energy and optimized atomic positions.
description: Optimized pristine C3B monolayer structure and total energy.

title: Mg atom adsorption on C3B monolayer
action: Place a Mg atom at the hollow site of the optimized C3B monolayer and perform spin-polarized DFT relaxation (PBE+DFT-D2). Record total energy and optimized geometry.
description: Optimized Mg-adsorbed C3B system and total energy.

title: Geometry optimization of isolated gas molecules
action: Perform DFT optimization of each isolated gas molecule (NO, N2O, NO2, NH3) in a sufficiently large periodic box. Record their total energies.
description: Optimized geometries and total energies of isolated gas molecules.

title: Calculate adsorption energies and equilibrium distances for all gas/substrate combinations
action: For each gas molecule, perform geometry optimization of the gas adsorbed on the Mg site of the Mg-C3B system (including two orientations for NO and NO2: N-end and O-end) and on the pristine C3B surface. Using the total energies from previous steps, compute adsorption energies E_ad = E(complex) - E(substrate) - E(gas) and equilibrium distances d from the relaxed geometries. Output all results to step_01_results.csv.
description: CSV containing computed adsorption energies and equilibrium distances for all gas-substrate combinations. Includes Mg-C3B (with required configurations) and pristine C3B substrates.
output_schema: Columns: system (str, one of 'Mg-C3B' or 'pristine_C3B'), gas (str, one of 'NO','N2O','NO2','NH3'), configuration (str, for Mg-C3B: 'I' (N-end) or 'II' (O-end) for NO and NO2, 'N-end' for others; for pristine_C3B: single entry per gas with empty configuration), E_ad (float, eV), d (float, Å; leave empty or 0 for pristine entries).
